title: Shortest Path in Grid with Obstacles
prompt:
Implement `shortest_path(grid: list[list[int]], start: tuple[int, int], end: tuple[int, int]) -> int` in `solution.py`.
`grid` is a 2D matrix where 0 represents an open cell and 1 represents an obstacle.
You can move in 4 directions: up, down, left, right.
Return the number of cells in the shortest path from `start` (row, col) to `end` (row, col) inclusive.
If no valid path exists, or if start or end is blocked, return -1.
